STS2ARIS-CLASS_ALTAR.title: Class Altar
STS2ARIS-CLASS_ALTAR.pages.INITIAL.descr:
You arrive at the ruins where you first awoke. A [red][sine]familiar voice[/sine][/red] echoes in your mind...

[red]‘O [jitter]<Princess>[/jitter], this altar is imbued with the power of the [jitter]Nameless Gods[/jitter].’[/red]

[red]‘Princess, picture the person you wish to become.’[/red]

[red]‘What you envision shall become reality. As your [sine]maid[/sine], I will abide by your choice.’[/red]
STS2ARIS-CLASS_ALTAR.pages.IRONCLAD.desc:
[blue]‘Aris is a [sine]warrior[/sine] now!’[/blue]

[red]‘Understood. [jitter]Princess[/jitter]—no, [sine]Aris[/sine]. This is your choice, and your right.’[/red]

You feel a [jitter][red]mighty strength[/red][/jitter] welling up within you.
STS2ARIS-CLASS_ALTAR.pages.SILENT.descri:
[blue]‘Aris is a [sine]rogue[/sine] now!’[/blue]

[red]‘Understood. [jitter]Princess[/jitter]—no, [sine]Aris[/sine]. This is your choice, and your right.’[/red]

You feel your body become [jitter][green]astonishingly light[/green][/jitter].
STS2ARIS-CLASS_ALTAR.pages.DEFECT.descri:
[blue]‘Aris is a [sine]defect[/sine] now!’[/blue]

[red]‘[jitter]Princess[/jitter]...? What exactly do you mean by “defect”?’[/red]

Despite the name, you feel your body become [jitter][blue]perfect[/blue][/jitter].
STS2ARIS-CLASS_ALTAR.pages.NECROBINDER.d:
[blue]‘Aris is a [sine]mage[/sine] of darkness now!’[/blue]

[red]‘That, too, is your choice. As your maid, I shall honor it.’[/red]

You feel a [jitter][purple]dark power[/purple][/jitter] stirring within you.
STS2ARIS-CLASS_ALTAR.pages.REGENT.descri:
[blue]‘Aris is a [sine]princess[/sine] now!’[/blue]

[red]‘Indeed, [jitter]Princess[/jitter]. That is your true nature and purp—’[/red]

[blue]‘A king sits arrogantly upon a huge throne and commands [sine]minions[/sine]! And Aris needs a royal shade of orange!’[/blue]

[red]‘A [sine]king, Princess[/sine]...? Whatever do you mean...?’[/red]

It seems you and your maid have slightly different ideas, but you feel a [jitter][orange]mighty orange power[/orange][/jitter].
STS2ARIS-CLASS_ALTAR.pages.HOSHINO.descr:
[blue]‘Aris is an [sine]old-timer[/sine] now!’[/blue]

[red]‘Underst—wait, [jitter]Princess[/jitter]...?’[/red]

[blue]‘Aris hasn't even moved, but it's already so hot!’[/blue]

Leaving your bewildered maid behind, you feel the [jitter][pink]responsibility of a student council president[/pink][/jitter].
STS2ARIS-CLASS_ALTAR.pages.KEI.descripti:
[blue]‘Aris is [jitter]Kei[/jitter] now!’[/blue]

[red]‘A-[sine]Aris[/sine]? What in the world are you...’[/red]

[blue]‘Aris will become a tsundere who pretends not to care, reluctantly does everything anyway, and gets all lovey-dovey with Sensei!’[/blue]

[red]‘[jitter]Ariiiiiis!????[/jitter]’[/red]

Leaving the flustered voice behind, you take up a new weapon and depart.
STS2ARIS-CLASS_ALTAR.pages.HEAL.descript:
[blue]‘Aris is Aris. Nothing else—just Aris, a member of the Game Development Department.’[/blue]

[red]‘Understood. [jitter]Princess[/jitter]—no, [sine]Aris[/sine]. May your whole being overflow with possibilities yet unreached.’[/red]

You feel no new power as you leave the altar, but there is a lightness in your [sine]step[/sine].
